result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/req518-compiler-scope-filter.md (design only). Three PRs: 2c-i (compiler scope arg as required third positional argument, ScopeDeclaration from installed-module manifests, Scope.allowed_set + ScopeNodePaths.allowed_node_ids, ON-clause predicate per join hop, ScopeGate, nine call sites, three :filter routes, AC 21 self-service list and walk rules), 2c-ii (ScopedLookup one-query by-id gate before body, old/new value check inside Records, all-or-nothing import pre-check, attachment parent gate, 8 resolver routes plus 7 declared tenant_wide), 2d (tasks.scope_node_id migration with no writer, F1 via Scope.allowed? with fresh in-transaction grants, 7 task routes, docs strings). Route inventory of 28 routes with class, handler and scope-application point; 35 mutants; AC map. Findings: stale FACTS line numbers; no total field exists on query/export/task list; managed-type write lock makes scope-aware writes unreachable unless declarations may cover unmanaged module-shipped types (SEC R-3); import is partial-success today; attachment nonexistent behavior differs per route; no reference validation on write path; StepWrites seam out of scope; about 67 forced test edits for the arity change. AC 23 (PR #2801) is NOT merged and was not read: mapped from the coordinator message (per-slice SEC passes, ledger, runtime before-send backstop). Deny-reason set: 518 adds none; four copies named (Scope.deny_reason, ShadowEvidence, migration CHECK, metrics/registry.ex @scope_shadow_reasons) with a design-added agreement test. NOTE for ORCH: handoffs/registry.json has no entry for this run id (lint H5). REWORK r1 (CDV FAIL G1-G3): F1 default is the literal TASK_WORKER grant via Scope.allowed_for_role?/3 and allowed_set_for_role/2 with negative tests T-F15 (scoped PROCESS_OPERATOR and TENANT_ADMIN refused), assign/reassign on the route permission, wider reading kept as OQ-3 only; unmanaged-type declarations limited to test-only modules via Catalog rule 11 plus a config/test.exs allowlist (T-D8), R-3 restated, R-7 corrected (:tenant_wide declaration is not restrictive-only), new R-8 (AC 6-9 over HTTP proven on the fixture only); 2c-i split into 2c-i-a (compiler, declaration, call sites, no route reclassified) and 2c-i-b (ScopeGate, backstop, route classes, self-service); explicit 5-commit order for 2d; scope-404 telemetry event [:letflow,:scope,:not_found] named; attachment create short-circuits before the multipart read (T-W20); mutants renamed MU1..MU38; OQ-8 states the backstop can turn a committed 2xx into a 500. REWORK r2 (SEC design gate PASS_WITH_FINDINGS): C-1 allowed_set raises ScopeSetError on any allowed_node_ids error and on the 50,000-id cap (T-C13, T-C14, MU40, MU41); C-2 retired intermediate node with live descendant in the fixture; C-3 pure new-value check before the transaction and idempotency claim (T-W22, MU39); C-4 :f1_scope plain read on the Multi repo after the task lock, T-F17; C-5 T-W21; C-6 T-W23; C-7 rulings recorded in section 8 (R-1 SEC-518-R1 literal form is the build default, threading fallback removed; R-2 ids SEC-518-R2-modules and SEC-518-R2-help so all three self-service routes are :self_service), AC 23 PR checklist 7.5, config/test.exs :modules SEC trigger; R-3 prod-config evaluation in T-D8; R-4 detective-only conditions; advisories A-1..A-8; RA-13 conditions (AC 13 text amendment before 2d merges).
